title: Ivy fails with firebase

milestone.title: Backlog

body:
# 🐞 bug report ### Is this a regression? Yes, this is a regression ### Description AngularFire works well with v7 and v8 without Ivy, but turning on Ivy prevents me from doing builds. ## 🔬 Minimal Reproduction https://github.com/StephenFluin/ivy-firebase-repro/commits/master 1. Create new app 1. Add firebase & realtime database 1. Update to v8 (works) 1. Turn on Ivy (fails) ## 🔥 Exception or Error
